organic.title: Nintendo - Wikipedia
organic.snippet: Nintendo Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational video game company headquartered in Kyoto. It was founded in 1889 by Fusajiro Yamauchi.

organic.title: Company History | Nintendo
organic.snippet: Nintendo was founded as a playing card manufacturer.

organic.title: Fusajiro Yamauchi
organic.snippet: Fusajiro Yamauchi was a Japanese businessman who founded Nintendo.
